reason: Protocol v1 holdout trajectories were included in an exploratory smoke run and are retained only as historical diagnostic evidence.

public_train_tune.smoke_seed_selection: execution.smoke_seed_offset selects one seed inside each eligible split
acceptance: Improvement is required independently on train and tune trajectories.
No previously passing trajectory and exact bias-vector group may become failing.
Signed mirror-pair asymmetry must not worsen.
Attitude, navigation, NIS/NEES, health, recovery, and covariance checks must remain within predeclared tolerances.

requirements: Use new trajectory variants and seed values that were not executed or inspected during v1 work.
Keep the concrete seed and trajectory manifest outside the tuning branch until candidate freeze.
Record the sealed manifest SHA-256 before execution.
Freeze the candidate source commit, runner binary, compiler flags, protocol, gates, and material-regression tolerances before execution.
Execute the holdout once; any subsequent estimator tuning requires protocol v3 while retaining v2 evidence.

freeze_blockers: Implement and review the new holdout trajectory variants.
Select clean immutable baseline and candidate commits from train/tune evidence only.
Install the sealed manifest and one-shot execution control in protected CI.
